# BTicino C300X Integration v2.8.2

## 2026-11-22

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/oliver7557)

2.8.2 brings optional display-matched High video, improved on-demand recovery
and verified restoration of device files. These notes cover everything new
since 2.7.0.

## On-demand video keeps running

Opening the camera on demand sometimes ended by itself one to three seconds
after the picture started, most often for a viewer on WiFi. The agent closed
the connection when the viewer took the video a little late. It now skips
packets that have not started instead, allowing the viewer to recover without
reopening the camera. The picture can temporarily lose frames. Media writes
remain bounded for other viewers; an unfinished partial packet or five seconds
without sending a complete media packet still closes the connection.
Needs the agent update.

Agent restarts also wake an idle network loop immediately, including when a
worker thread receives the shutdown signal. This avoids delayed shutdowns
during updates. Needs the agent update.

## Firewall patch off restores the original

Turning the firewall patch off gives back the device's firewall script exactly
as it was. Before, it lost its trailing blank line. Needs the agent update.

Restoring call routing now verifies the complete original backup against the
installed firmware, including interrupted patches. Damaged or foreign backups
are rejected, and the restored file is staged and verified before use.
Needs the agent update.

## The C300X speaks

The device's own loudspeaker is now a media player in Home Assistant. Let it
say whatever your automations want to tell you at the door:

```yaml
action: tts.speak
target:
  entity_id: tts.piper
data:
  media_player_entity_id: media_player.bticino_c300x_speaker
  message: The washing machine is done.
```

- **Local:** the speech comes from the text-to-speech engine you choose. With
  Piper nothing leaves your network.
- **Spoken notifications:** the Notify action has a new `mode`: on the
  display as before, only spoken (`speech`), or shown and spoken instead of
  the tone (`both`). Choose the engine and language once under
  **Configure > Speech**.
- **The door comes first:** a ring or a call ends a sound at once, and no
  sound starts while a call is under way or for a minute after a ring.
- Sounds from the media browser play too, with a volume and a stop.
- **Says what it does:** the speaker shows **Ready** or **Playing** with a
  matching icon, and its last result in words, for example **Interrupted by a
  call or camera view**.

The sound is telephone quality (8000 Hz), which is all the device plays.
Tested on firmware 1.7.19; firmware 2.0.2 and 3.0.6 have the same sound parts
but are not tested yet. Needs the agent update.

## Better camera picture

The camera picture can now be clearly better than from the factory. Under
**Configure > Camera quality** you choose:

- **Sharper:** up to 3000 kbit/s instead of 800.
- **Smoother:** up to 24 frames per second instead of 15. 25 is not offered,
  because the device then sends only about 8.
- **Display-matched proportions:** optional **960x576** on the verified C300X
  1.7.19 and 2.0.2 media builds. It keeps all 576 source rows, removes the side margins,
  and scales the picture horizontally in the existing hardware before encoding.
  The resulting 5:3 picture matches the 800x480 display. There is no extra
  encoding pass, but horizontal scaling does not create new camera detail.
- The original **688x480** crop and **704x576** full-height raster remain
  available. The latter's pixel dimensions do not match the display's 5:3 shape.

Selecting 960x576 applies a hash-checked binary patch with an original backup
on the device. Unknown builds are not patched. Choosing an original size
restores the original program; removing the agent restores it as well.
No manufacturer binary or extracted firmware files are distributed.

The C300X reads these values only when it starts, so saving a change restarts
it once, which takes about a minute. The form shows the values saved on the
device and the ones it runs with. Removing the agent puts the original values
back. Needs the agent update.

The 960x576 live stream and 800x480 display image were tested on firmware
1.7.19. Firmware 2.0.2 was checked offline against its original binary,
configuration and media libraries; it has a separate exact hash pair and is
not hardware-tested. This does not establish a 960x576 answering-machine
recording format.

### Matching snapshots and card

New visitor snapshot settings use **800x480**, the display framebuffer's native
pixels. Without a cached stream size, the card starts with the same 5:3
proportions as 960x576 live video. A newly playing stream updates its measured
dimensions; older streams keep their own shape. Existing explicit snapshot
sizes are preserved: choose **800x480** under **Visitor snapshot** to use the
native shape. Increasing video resolution does not increase snapshot detail.

On firmware 3.0.6 the area sets the low-resolution stream, the only one that
firmware sends, which the Door Entry app receives as well: sizes from 352x288
to 720x576, 100-2000 kbit/s and up to 25 frames per second. Sizes other than
the factory 400x288 are not tested on a 3.0.6 device yet.

## Display pages from the settings

Submitting **Configure > Display > Display and Display patch** with **Home
Assistant pages on the display** turned on now installs the pages on the C300X;
turned off, it restores the original display. A new setup does it at its first
start. Before, only the **Display patch** switch did that, which was disabled by
default. The switch now saves
the option too, and it is shown by default in new setups. If your pages are
missing after the update, open **Display and Display patch** and submit it once.

Restoring the Display patch no longer reports `display_library_restore_failed`
after it has put the display library back. Agent commands on the C300X lost
their output when it went to a pipe, so the Display patch script read nothing
from the agent. Needs the agent update.

## No SSH login to type in

Installing the agent, at setup and in the agent Repair, logs in with the C300X
factory root login. User and password are asked for only when the device
refuses it, for example after the root password was changed.

## Clearer settings

- **Camera quality** appears before **Visitor snapshot** in the options menu.
- **Activations:** the step says that further door locks and lights, for
  example for a second door, are added there, one activation each.
- **Visitor snapshot size:** the form explains the independent 800x480 display
  source, its 480-pixel height limit and 5:3 sizing. Other proportions stretch
  that display image; matching the encoded video's old pixel dimensions is
  not the same as preserving the display image's shape.

## Audio codec on firmware 3.0.6

The **Audio codec** select can now switch to **Speex** on firmware 3.0.6 too,
which comes with PCMU; it failed there before. This is not tested on a 3.0.6
device yet. Removing the agent puts back the codec the device came with.

## Tip: clearer sound with PCMU

If your C300X runs the factory Speex codec (firmware 1.7.19 and 2.0.2), set the **Audio codec**
select to **PCMU**. The browser plays PCMU as it is, so the agent no longer
converts the sound; that gives clearer audio and leaves the device more room.
Switching restarts the C300X once. The switch writes the same codec settings
BTicino itself ships on firmware 3.0.6, which already runs PCMU from the
factory.
